sources_considered.why: Provides an end-2025 estimate and explicitly describes its evidential weaknesses.
Confirms the methodology was released before the post.
Primary procurement announcement; its capacity was expected in 2026 rather than confirmed operational in 2025.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI wrote a memo for its investors estimating Anthropic had 1.4 GW of data center capacity as of the end of 2025, about three-quarters of OpenAI’s claimed capacity. Since this is OpenAI’s potentially-biased estimate about another company, this is more uncertain than OpenAI’s disclosure of its own capacity.

evidence_items.explanation: A documented estimate above one gigawatt existed before the post. Its reliance on a rival's estimate, and the methodology's separate discussion of conflicting spending evidence, prevent treating it as verified operational capacity.
The agreement is evidence of prospective access exceeding one gigawatt. It does not establish that this capacity was operational by the end of 2025.

unresolved_gaps: No reconciled operational inventory establishes Anthropic's year-end 2025 allocation in a consistent gigawatt measure.
No reliable upper bound establishes that less than one gigawatt was available.
The conclusion changes if future contracted capacity counts as compute available to buy.
